description: A RELATIVE KEY clause that is not a phrase of the ACCESS MODE clause — a COBOL-2002 relaxation of a COBOL-85 restriction, QUOTED from ISO/IEC 1989:2002 Annex F.2 item 112: "RELATIVE KEY clause. A RELATIVE KEY clause may be specified by itself in a file control entry. Previously, RELATIVE KEY was required to be specified as a phrase of the ACCESS MODE clause." COBOL-85 is the edition a 2002 Annex F.2 'formerly' statement describes: the owner's decision of 2026-10-31 (kb/Work PB4305) makes the F.2 statements the rule for the 85 edge, as D-SIGN2 (item 124) and PB3683 (item 123) did; GnuCOBOL -std=cobol85 accepts some of them as dialect leniency, which rule 1 places below the ISO text. Gated in ONE place, VersionConformancePass.ParseArm.VisitRelativeKeyClause (kb/Work PB4305; VCR row 7.47).
display: a RELATIVE KEY clause that is not a phrase of the ACCESS MODE clause

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. VMRKA.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
FILE-CONTROL.
    SELECT F ASSIGN TO "VMRKA"
        ORGANIZATION IS RELATIVE
        RELATIVE KEY IS RK.
DATA DIVISION.
FILE SECTION.
FD F.
01 R PIC X(10).
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 RK PIC 9(4).
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    STOP RUN.
